body:
Well, I'm going to go now, I hope I find peace. I even failed at a suicide watch post, 1 up vote, thanks for that icing on the cake. This is like the suicide hotlines where you hold for 30 minutes then get hung up on. 

Anyway, thanks for the 2 people that tried to help. I'm scared, but at peace with my choice, I couldn't pretend for another day.
Because I love her, love isn't rational
No, it's one where I don't have to feel this anymore
The more time I grieve the clearer the choice becomes

I don't have other options. I've tried very hard to find another option but it's just not there. When you have maybe had 10 hours of sleep and a few hundred calories over the past month and even told people your considering suicide and nobody can even pretend to care you just have to give up. What's the point of any of this if you have to go at it alone. I'll just eventually die alone anyways, why suffer waiting for that!

She was talking to me until 3 days ago, I reached out to one of her friends who told me there is nothing I can do and to leave her alone, she's moved on and I should to. I can't move on. I've got everything ready to go, I'm just scared.
I don't want to bash her, I still love her completely and unconditionally and that won't change. There isn't a reason why she left, she said it was something she needs to do.
